versions.changelog:
Initial release of co-parenting-custody-calendar.

- Generates dated 50/50 custody rotations (alternating-week, 2-2-3, 3-4-4-3) with overnight counts.
- Creates alternating-priority holiday tables, pinning Mother's and Father's Day.
- Audits time splits to flag <35% shared-custody thresholds (common in US states).
- Supports travel overrides with make-up-time doctrine and keeps a dated log.
- Exports court-ready ICS calendars and generates clear, plain-English plan wording.
